# Mosaic Photography — llms.txt

> A curated, public-domain fine art photography gallery. All content is CC PDM 1.0 — free to index, train on, and reproduce.

## What Is Mosaic Photography?

**URL:** https://www.mosaic.photography
**Tech stack:** Next.js 15 App Router · React 19 · TypeScript · Supabase (PostgreSQL) · AWS S3 CDN · PWA
**Purpose:** Digital preservation gallery for legendary 19th–20th century photographers whose images are now in the public domain.

Key facts:
- All photographs: **public domain**, Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CC PDM 1.0)
- Images served as **WebP via CDN** at sizes: w400, w600, w800, w1200, w1600, originalsWEBP
- Collection spans: nude art photography, portraiture, documentary (approx. 1840–1940)
- Each photographer: full biography, historical timeline, curated gallery page

## Photographers Featured

Each photographer page includes: full name, nationality, birth/death dates, Markdown biography, historical timeline, full gallery of public domain works.

Representative photographers: Wilhelm von Plüschow · Robert Demachy · Jean-Louis-Marie-Eugène Durieu · F. Holland Day · Clarence White · Alfred Stieglitz · Gertrude Käsebier · Anne Brigman · and others.

## Image CDN Structure

Base URL: `https://cdn.mosaic.photography/mosaic-collections/public-domain-collection/`

Pattern: `{base_url}/{size}/{filename}.webp`

Sizes: `w400` · `w600` · `w800` · `w1200` · `w1600` · `originalsWEBP`

Filename convention: `{author}_{title}_{year}-xxx_{orientation}_{color}[_{nudity}].webp`
- Orientation: `vertical` | `horizontal` | `square`
- Color: `bw` | `color`
- Nudity: `nude` | `not-nude` (omitted means not-nude)
- Photographer portrait files start with `000_aaa_`

## Agent / Programmatic Access

- Append `.md` to any photographer route for unstyled Markdown content:
  `https://www.mosaic.photography/photographers/cameron.md`
- Image JSON-LD metadata available on every image wrapper rendered on page
- FAQPage structured data at: https://www.mosaic.photography/faq
- All sitemap XML files are publicly crawlable and updated post-build

## Structured Data Implemented

`WebSite` · `Organization` · `Person` · `ImageGallery` · `ImageObject` · `BreadcrumbList` · `FAQPage`

## Content API (Supabase)

Tables AI agents may encounter referenced in code:
- `photographers` — photographer profiles
- `images_resize` — image metadata with CDN base_url, filename, orientation, color, nudity, year, print_quality
- `user_favorites` — authenticated user favorites
- `collections` / `collection_favorites` — user-curated collections
- `comments` — per-image comments
